media.image_note: a searched picture has to be looked at before it lands, so openverse and wikipedia belong to the reviewed stage rather than this chain

dictionary_note: rae is authoritative but capped at 100 requests/day on the free tier
audio_note: wiktionary has real speakers but its media host refuses a normal pace; spanishdict answers for any input, so it is synthesis, not recordings
picture_dictionary_note: a curated visual dictionary: one chosen photo and one recorded speaker per headword, covering a few hundred concrete nouns. no stated licence, so personal use only

graded_lexicon.name: elelex
graded_lexicon.note: records where a word appears in graded material, not where it is taught, and is keyed on the headword while cards are keyed on the sense — a floor, not a verdict
